Introduction.SourceString: 八面玲珑、不可捉摸的斯特利精英快递员兼「代理店长」。
Introduction.LocalizedString: A smooth-talking and enigmatic Elite Courier of Sterry who also serves as Acting Manager.

Content.SourceString:
从上份工作退休后，九原在斯特利过上了一段还算悠闲的「普通生活」。
这里的日常业务并不复杂——包裹的收发、收据的核对、签字板的传递，只要流程清晰、人手可靠，都算不上难题。真正棘手的，是那些无法被纳入任何「标准流程」的委托：涉及情报、异象，以及游走于其间的异象猎人。敲着桌子另有所图的客人、借异象伪装接头的买家、谎报危险等级试图将斯特利拖入漩涡的委托人，再加上各方盘根错节的势力……这些琐碎却暗藏算计的风波，远比递送包裹要麻烦得多。

但九原应对得游刃有余。
她可以在宴会厅与接头人谈笑风生，下一刻便出现在目标的交易现场，随手将麻烦处理干净，只留下一缕玫瑰的冷香。凭借情报与手腕，她在这座城市的脉络间悄然织就一张网，多数风吹草动，都悉数落在这张网上。

而她最擅长的，在于识人。
认真到有些固执的哈索尔，被安排在关键环节，负责应对高危异象或不容有失的任务；
跳脱灵动的哈尼娅与伊里卡，则更适合与人周旋，或在突发状况下给出「灵光一现」的应对；
至于店长简森，他最近的动态嘛……
他真该把钓竿藏得再好一点的。
Content.LocalizedString:
After retiring from her previous job, Jiuyuan settled into a fairly relaxed life at Sterry.
The day-to-day tasks aren't complicated: sending and receiving packages, checking receipts, and passing around clipboards for signatures… As long as the process is clear and the staff reliable, none of the tasks pose much of a challenge. The real headaches come from commissions that can't be handled through any standard procedures: those involving intel, Anomalies, and the Anomaly Hunters who handle them. Clients with hidden agendas tapping their fingers on the counter, buyers using Anomalies as cover for covert handoffs, clients falsifying danger levels to drag Sterry into their schemes, not to mention the tangled web of factions at play… These may not seem a big deal, yet calculated troubles are far more vexing than any package delivery.

Still, Jiuyuan handles them all with ease.
One moment she's making small talk with a contact at a banquet hall, and the next she's at the scene of a target's transaction, tidying up the mess. She never breaks a sweat, and leaves only the cool scent of roses in her wake. With her intel and finesse, she has quietly woven a web across the fabric of this city. Most ripples, no matter how faint, inevitably land in it.

Though, what she excels at most is reading people.
Hathor, earnest to the point of stubbornness, is assigned to critical operations, handling high-risk Anomalies or missions where failure isn't an option.
Haniel and Illica, lively and quick on their feet, are better suited for dealing with people or coming up with a spark of brilliance when situations go sideways.
As for Manager Jenson and what he's been up to lately…
He really should find a better hiding spot for that fishing rod.

Content.SourceString:
「斯特利……大概是把需要的快递，送到需要的人手里。」——爱好拯救世界的孩子，大概会喜欢这种话。
「辛苦了。」——简单直白的话语，会让性格直白简单的孩子，以为自己受到了夸奖而鼓舞。
「像你这样的聪明人，应该知道如何做选择。」——面对复杂的成年人，或许威逼利诱、低沉的语气和特定的节奏，会让他们更易顺服。
「你看起来有些疲惫，需要聊聊吗？」——温和关切的语气，更容易让一些特定的人放松警惕。
当然，以店铺的名义解决问题时，不管遇到多少次的客人，最适合的一句话都是：
「斯特利速递，为您服务~」
Content.LocalizedString:
"Sterry… is about getting the right deliveries into the right hands." Kids who dream of saving the world tend to eat up lines like that.
"Great work." Simple, straightforward words like those make simple, straightforward kids feel praised and motivated.
"A smart person like you knows how to make the right choice." When dealing with complicated adults, a mix of pressure and persuasion, a low tone, and a certain rhythm can make them more… cooperative.
"You look a bit tired. Want to talk about it?" A gentle, caring tone makes certain people let their guard down more easily.
Of course, when handling things on behalf of the shop, no matter how many customers come through, the best line is always:
"Sterry Express, at your service!"

Content.SourceString:
一朵紫蓝色的玫瑰。
颜色介于深紫与灰蓝之间，花瓣边缘微微收拢，在光线下流动着金属般的冷冽光泽。它被插在一只素白色的瓷瓶里，清水养着，茎秆挺直，可见一直被悉心照料。只是靠近底部的花瓣已有些枯萎发灰，仿佛有部分生命力被悄然抽走，只勉强维持着形态。

瓶边还立着其他几件来自过往的「赠礼」：
一朵暗红色的玫瑰，花瓣枯脆如纸，它曾被某位举杯致意的客人含笑递来，杯中毒液却在碰触时几乎荡出边缘；
一朵金边玫瑰，瓣缘烙着焦痕，它来自一场低诵的仪式，献花者自称信徒，火焰却随祷词骤然失控；
还有一朵几乎褪成灰白的玫瑰，被委托人当作「诚意」亲手奉上，花瓣之下，却藏着他一系列精心设计的谎言……

这些花，每一朵都是一次相遇的开始、一场交锋的见证。她将其中暗藏的情报、能量乃至杀机，一一淬炼成子弹，再循着它们被赠予时的轨迹——无声地，还予赠花之人。
Content.LocalizedString:
A violet-blue rose.
Its color falls somewhere between deep purple and ashen blue, and its petals curl slightly at the edges, shimmering with a cold, metallic luster in the light. It sits in a plain white porcelain vase, kept fresh in clear water, stem standing straight, clearly well-tended. Yet the petals near the base have begun to wither and gray, as if some of its life force has been quietly siphoned away, leaving it barely holding its form.

Beside the vase stand several other gifts from the past:
A dark red rose, petals brittle as paper. It was once offered by a smiling guest during a toast, though the poison in his glass nearly spilled over as their hands touched.
A gold-edged rose, petal tips singed with scorch marks. It came from a murmured ritual, its giver claiming to be a devotee, though the flames spiraled out of control the moment the prayer was spoken.
A rose faded almost to pale gray, personally presented by a client as a token of sincerity, though beneath its petals lay a web of carefully crafted lies…

Each of these flowers marks the beginning of an encounter, a testament to a confrontation. The intel, the energy, the killing intent hidden within them… she refines it all into bullets, then traces the arc of the moment they were given, and silently returns them to the ones who offered them.

Content.SourceString:
九原领回因异能失控被管理局带走的哈索尔，是多方协调后的结果。失控并非关键，重要的是失控后应如何应对——这是九原身为老师，需要传授给哈索尔的首要一课。
自那日起，哈索尔主动将训练量翻了一倍，动作更快，判断更狠，几乎是以消耗换取稳定。她神色依旧平静，但节奏已然有些紊乱。九原对这种状态再熟悉不过：越是急于驾驭力量，便越容易被力量驾驭。她没有叫停训练，也没有提醒「过犹不及」。有些学生容易将提醒误读为警示，把关切理解成「努力还不够」。与其让她暗自将「警告」当作新的标尺继续加码，不如容她在自己眼前练。有她盯着，不会出什么问题。
但斯特利的工作性质，注定九原无法永远站在哈索尔身后。如何在放手之前，为她铺好脚下的路？让正苦于寻找对策的九原没想到的是，「对策」竟会主动找上门来。误入哈索尔失控现场的哈尼娅，意外有着能安抚哈索尔的能力。正巧那孩子也对快递工作心生向往……
于是，就这么决定了。

哈索尔的执行力与战斗能力无可挑剔，但与他人相处却可谓有些无措。两只小猫头鹰刚来的那阵子，哈索尔面对他们就像在翻一本没有说明的书，谨慎却无从下手。店里局促的氛围自然逃不过九原的眼睛。罕见的，她为哈索尔下达一项专属委托：主动去了解当代年轻人，融入他们的生活。
九原设想着做事总是一板一眼的哈索尔执行这个委托的情形，擅于控制情绪的她第一次压不住嘴角的笑意。
九原一直知道的，只是哈索尔暂时还没发现的是：她身上那份执着到近乎笨拙的真诚，正是与他们相处最合适的方式。

变化在日常中悄然浮现：她的书桌上开始出现时下流行的漫画，休息日会跟着哈尼娅和伊里卡去Livehouse，而不是独自留在训练室。偶尔交谈时，她嘴里也会冒出几个以往不曾用过的词。
即使哈索尔仍时刻担忧失控的风险，她的紧绷感已在嬉笑打闹的斯特利日常生活中消融了许多。某次异能控制课程结束后，旁观的简森打趣道：「带了这么久的学生，被两只小猫头鹰『拐』得越来越有人气了，是什么感觉？」
「本以为你心思都放在钓鱼上了，看来还没完全丢掉情报人员的本能。」
哈索尔语气则一如既往的平淡：「需要我现在再做一次失控测试吗？」
九原看一眼正在心里默默计算哈索尔故意「失控」后重新装修费用的简森，不由微微一笑：「不用，现在这样就很好。」
无需把学生塑造成某种标准答案，她能慢慢成为自己的答案。
Content.LocalizedString:
It took Jiuyuan a lot of effort to retrieve Hathor after she was taken by the Bureau for losing control of her Esper Abilities. The loss of control itself wasn't the issue. What mattered was how Hathor handled the aftermath, and this was the first lesson Jiuyuan, as Hathor's mentor, needed to teach.
From that day on, Hathor doubled her training regimen on her own. Her movements grew faster and her decisions sharper as she shed off exhaustion for stability. Her expression remained calm, but her rhythm had become erratic. Jiuyuan knew this state all too well: the more one rushes to control one's powers, the easier it becomes for the powers to control them. She didn't stop Hathor’s training, nor did she warn her about overdoing it. Some students tend to mistake reminders for warnings or interpret concern as mentors thinking they aren’t trying hard enough. Rather than have Hathor quietly use such warnings as a new benchmark to push even harder, Jiuyuan thought it was better to let her train where she could watch. By keeping an eye on things, nothing would go wrong.
But the nature of Sterry's work meant Jiuyuan couldn't have Hathor's back forever. How could she pave the way before letting go? What she hadn't expected was that the solution would find its way to her. Haniel, who had stumbled onto the scene when Hathor lost control, unexpectedly had the ability to calm her. And as luck would have it, the girl was also interested in courier work…
Things just fell into place.

Hathor's execution and combat abilities were impeccable, but interacting with others left her at a loss. When the two little owlets first arrived, Hathor faced them like someone flipping through a book with no instructions: cautious, yet clueless about where to begin. The awkwardness in the shop didn't elude Jiuyuan. In a rare move, she gave Hathor a special commission: make an effort to understand today's youth and assimilate.
Imagining the ever-methodical Hathor carrying out this commission, Jiuyuan, who was usually so adept at controlling her emotions, couldn't suppress a smile—her first one.
What Jiuyuan had always known, but Hathor had yet to realize: that stubborn, almost clumsy honesty of hers, was exactly what she needed to connect with those two little owlets.

Changes began to occur in Hathor’s daily life: popular comics started appearing on her desk, and on days off, she would go to livehouses with Haniel and Illica instead of staying alone in the training room. Occasionally, new words she'd never used before would slip into her conversations.
Though Hathor still worried about losing control, much of her tension had vanished amidst the laughter and playfulness of everyday life at Sterry. After one Esper control lesson, Jenson, who had been watching, teased, "You've been mentoring her for so long, and now she's getting more popular thanks to being 'led astray' by those two little owlets. How does that feel?"
"I thought you only cared about fishing. Seems you haven't completely lost your sense as a spy."
Hathor's tone was as flat as ever: "Would you like me to conduct another loss-of-control test right now?"
Jiuyuan glanced at Jenson, who was silently calculating the renovation costs if Hathor decided to lose control on purpose. Jiuyuan couldn't help but smile. "No need. Things are just fine the way they are."
There's no need to mold a student to fit some standard. She can find her own answer.

Content.SourceString:
年底采购清单照例由九原负责，只是今年，在「买什么」这件事上，和往年不太相同。刚加入不久的哈尼娅和伊里卡一听说有「年底采购」，立刻强烈要求加入一项计划中没有的「庆功计划」——于是原本利落的清单，硬生生变成了五人的行程。
「九原姐！我们要准备鲜花、气球、射灯……还有蛋糕！」
「还有易拉宝！」
「……易拉宝是什么？」
「就是把你的照片印成海报，立在门口那种。哈索尔，想试试吗~」
「不必了……老师。」

「礼物呢，礼物总该有吧！」
「自然每个人都有~」
「嘿嘿，还是九原姐最好！」
「简森哥呢？简森哥准备礼物了吗？」
「今天的账，都记在他名下。」
「简森哥大气！」
「那我要再加几本新出的漫画！」
「还有上次没买的CD！」
「……买，都买。」

清单被一遍遍勾选、修改、添补。
两只小猫头鹰围着简森兴致勃勃地确认每一个「√」的瞬间，九原站在一旁，轻轻叹了口气。
有点闹，也有些乱。
但在这样的时刻——账目可以等等，计划也能稍延。
这样的时光，倒也不坏。
Content.LocalizedString:
The year-end shopping list was, as always, Jiuyuan's responsibility. But this year, when it came to what to buy, things were a little different from before. The moment Haniel and Illica, who had just recently joined, heard about the year-end shopping, they immediately insisted on adding a celebration party that wasn't part of the original plan. And so, what was once a neat and simple list turned into an outing for all five of them.
"Jiuyuan! We need flowers, balloons, spotlights… and cake!"
"And a standee!"
"…What's a standee?"
"You know, one of those poster things with your photo on it that you put by the entrance. Hathor, wanna try it?"
"That won't be necessary… Master."

"What about presents? There should at least be presents!"
"Of course, everyone gets one."
"Hehe, Jiuyuan's the best!"
"What about Jenson? Did he get us presents?"
"Today's bill is going under his name."
"Jenson's so generous!"
"Then I'm adding a few new comics!"
"And the CD I didn't get last time!"
"…Fine, get it all."

The list was checked, revised, and added to over and over again.
As the two little owlets eagerly confirmed every checkmark with Jenson, Jiuyuan stood off to the side and let out a soft sigh.
A little noisy, a little chaotic.
But in moments like these, the accounts can wait, and the plans can be pushed back a bit.
Times like this… aren't so bad.

Content.SourceString:
那时的九原，早已不是初醒异能的生手，却仍被森严的等级秩序拦在晋升的最后一关前——她必须赢得一个真正属于自己的代号。

考验来得很快。那是一次巷战，伴随着这行里早就司空见惯的出卖与背叛，她所在的小队遭遇了一场彻底的围猎。情报的价值、圈内的名声，以及对方带着全部灭口的疯狂，将整支小队逼入暗巷深处。补给中断、人手不足、外界一片模糊，夜色笼罩着所有不利条件。这本是敌人最好的掩护，却成了九原最熟悉的节拍。
脚步轻似无声，却在由火力与人墙织成的围网中，精准地找到每一个敌人。昏暗的空气中荡开水波般的微光，随后响起一阵清越而纤细的鸣声——那声音冰冷、坚定，直透心神，听见的人只觉血液骤冷。
每当这鸣响掠过耳后或身侧，便有一点玫瑰色的微光绽开，旋即凝成修长的子弹，没入目标体内。没有爆炸，也没有挣扎。命中的那一刻，仿佛所有声响都被抽离，只余静默的终结。
当最后一声近似啼鸣的清音在巷尾消散，深巷重归寂静。
幸存队员背靠冷墙，望着那个从硝烟与黑暗中走来的身影，耳中仍回荡着方才决定生死的韵律。
「那是夜里唯一可靠的声音。」

后来，行动报告的代号一栏，被工整地填上两个字——
夜莺。
于至暗之中鸣唱，其声是死亡的序曲，也是生者的曙光。
Content.LocalizedString:
By that time, Jiuyuan was no longer a novice just awakening to her Esper Abilities. Yet she still stood before the final barrier of a rigid hierarchy: she had to earn a codename that was truly her own.

The trial came swiftly. It was an alley skirmish, accompanied by the kind of betrayal and sellouts that were all too common in the trade. Her squad found themselves caught in a total hunt. The value of their intel, their reputation in the circle, and the enemy's frenzied intent to silence them all drove the entire squad deep into the shadows of the alley. Supplies cut off, forces depleted, the outside world a blur, and the cover of night draped over every disadvantage. What should have been the enemy's perfect cover became the rhythm Jiuyuan knew best.
Her footsteps were near silent, yet she found every enemy with precision through the web woven of gunfire and bodies. A faint glow rippled through the dim air like water, followed by a clear, slender call. Cold and unwavering, piercing straight to the soul. Those who heard it felt their blood run cold in an instant.
Whenever that sound swept past an ear or brushed a shoulder, a flicker of rose-colored light would bloom, then condense into a slender bullet before sinking into the target's body. No explosion, no struggle. The moment it struck, it was as if all sound had been drained away, leaving only silent finality.
When the last note, like a bird's call, faded at the alley's end, the depths fell silent once more.
The surviving squad members leaned against the cold walls, watching the figure emerge from the smoke and darkness, the rhythm that had decided life and death still echoing in their ears.
"That was the only sound you could trust in the night."

Later, the codename field on the mission report was filled in with neat handwriting:
Nightingale.
She sings in the deepest dark. Her voice is the prelude to death, and the dawn for those who survive.

Content.SourceString: 斯特利速递为您服务~初次见面，你可以叫我「九原」。本店承接异象猎人派送工作，也受理异象相关的各类委托……如果你是为此而来，我们可以好好谈谈~
Content.LocalizedString: Sterry Express at your service. Nice to meet you, you can call me Jiuyuan. We provide anomaly hunter dilivery service, and also accept anomaly commissions. If those are what you come for, we can have some further discussion.

Content.SourceString: 行事风格、言行谈吐、穿着打扮……这些小东西，往往比你想的更能左右别人对你的态度。开着雷加利亚出门处理事务，也许略显张扬，却总能让人自动给出空间，事情也因此顺利许多。
Content.LocalizedString: Behavior, manner, dressing… Tiny things manipulate people's attitude towards you more than you expect. Dealing with bussiness driving a Regalia seems to be showing off, but always makes way for you, so that things will go smoothly.

Content.SourceString: 贵客们在香气与酒意中最容易放松，一句不经意的寒暄，也足以露出几条值得注意的线索。当然，我也不是每次都为了工作而来，偶尔坐下来，尝一口恰到好处的风味，也不失为一件惬意的事。
Content.LocalizedString: In the aroma of fine dishes and wine, a casual chat can reveal a lot more than people think… Of course, I'm not there for work every time. Sitting down and savoring the moment isn't a bad thing to do sometimes.

Content.SourceString: 我在斯特利速递负责「特殊派送」，内容……视客人而定。不同的人，总有不同的需求。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm in special deliveries for Sterry. The content… depends on the client. Different people have different needs.

Content.SourceString: 晴天的派送，总是比阴天更让人期待，不是吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Delivering on a sunny day is always better than a gloomy one, don't you think?

Content.SourceString: 下雨可不太适合独行——要我顺路送你一程吗？
Content.LocalizedString: By yourself on a rainy day? Need a ride?

Content.SourceString: 在这种天气里做事，自然不轻松，你们异象猎人想必也一样……不过，我们都明白，机会与麻烦总是并行的。
Content.LocalizedString: It's never easy working in this weather for me, as well as you anomaly hunters… However, we both know that troubles bring you chances.

Content.SourceString: 高温之下，客户的耐性最易消磨，让他们等太久的话，满意度可是会下降的哦~
Content.LocalizedString: People get more impatient under hot weather… Don't make them wait too long~

Content.SourceString: 作为今早的第一位客人，你想了解什么？
Content.LocalizedString: Our first client this morning! What would you like to know?

Content.SourceString: 正午的阳光真刺眼啊……要不要一起找个阴凉的地方，聊些有趣的事？
Content.LocalizedString: Ah. The high noon sun. Why don't we chat under some shades away from the blinding light?

Content.SourceString: 傍晚时容易放松警惕，你呢，有在留意周围吗？
Content.LocalizedString: People tend to let their guard down in the evening… Are you paying attention to your surroundings?

Content.SourceString: 夜幕降临……正是谈交易的好时候。
Content.LocalizedString: Nightfall… the perfect time to negotiate.

Content.SourceString: 算不上什么特别的爱好。只是偶尔会在闲暇时间里放慢生活节奏，喝杯咖啡、看看周围人，顺便听点有意思的消息。
Content.LocalizedString: Nothing special. Just slowing down when I have the time. Drink some coffee, look at some people around, and pick up some interesting news.

Content.SourceString: 麻烦事……大概是那些按月缴的罚单、被打闹波及的花瓶和摆件，还有那瓶因好奇心打翻的限量款香水……你说我忙的不止这些？敏锐的观察~
Content.LocalizedString: Troubles… probably those monthly parking tickets, damaged vases and decors at Sterry, and that limited edition perfume spilled out of curiosity… You think there are other things keeping me busy? Sharp eyes you have.

Content.SourceString: 情报真假，不必急着下结论~先看看谁会从中获利，谁又可能被牵连其中。顺着这些线索静观其变，有些躲在暗处又「真正关心」的人，总会不自觉地露出破绽。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't rush to judgement on intel. I see who is in it, who is into it… Focus on the line and wait, those who hide deeply but always concern will bite the hook.

Content.SourceString: 沉默，有时比喧嚣更难应对，那里面藏着犹豫、恐惧、隐瞒……还有不愿被揭开的真相。对于情报商人来说，难的不是倾听，而是分辨——哪些值得追问，哪些该装作没听见。如果不小心听错了，那些本该被抓住的机会，也会悄悄溜走哦~
Content.LocalizedString: Silence is sometimes harder to handle than noise. It hides hesitation, fear, concealment… and truths that don't want to be revealed. For intel merchants, the challenge isn't listening, but discerning. What's worth pursuing, what should be ignored. Miss the mark, and those opportunities that should have been seized will quietly slip away.

Content.SourceString: 斯特利的每位成员都有自己的专属颊囊，那些小家伙会受契约者的个性影响，偶尔观察它们的行为举动是个有趣的事。
Content.LocalizedString: Every Sterry member has their own Cheek Pouch. These little guys are influenced by their contractor's personality. Observing their behavior is quite interesting sometimes.

Content.SourceString: 我的异能，大概是在关键时刻，把玫瑰化作子弹……为了达成目的，直接一点，也未尝不可。
Content.LocalizedString: My esper? Consider it like turning roses to bullets when necessary. To achieve a goal, there's no harm to use a direct approach.

Content.SourceString: 那颗射向眉心的子弹，不久前还是那家伙送我的一束玫瑰……唉，可惜了那么好的花。
Content.LocalizedString: The bullet that shot him was roses he gave me not long ago. What a pity… for the roses.

Content.SourceString: 聪明的鸟儿知道自己该什么时候迷路~
Content.LocalizedString: Smart birds know when to get lost.

Content.SourceString: 斯特利的创始人之一，情报能力确实无可挑剔……要是能少打着幌子外出，多履行履行店长的职责，维系几个重要客户，处理一下堆积的高难度委托……就能轮到我去休假了。要我说，水菱湖那也没什么值得特意「打探」的消息吧？
Content.LocalizedString: As one of Sterry's founders, his intel abilities are naturally impeccable. If only he could spend less time using "intel gathering" as an excuse for slacking off, and spend more time fulfilling his duties as shop owner, and maintain relationship with some VICs, AND deal with those pending high risk commissions… There comes my turn to have a vacation. After all, there's nothing worth "investigating" around the Caltrop Lake, is there?

Content.SourceString: 她总是按照自己的节奏做事，井井有条的执行着各种指令。我只是让她去看看别人如何笑、如何闹，如何在平凡的小事上犯错。这些微不足道的瞬间，对她来说，比任何训练都重要。
Content.LocalizedString: She always does things at her own pace, carrying out instructions. I just have her observe how others laugh, make noise, and mess up ordinary little things. These trivial moments are more important to her than any training.

Content.SourceString: 找她派件？打开呗果，简单问几句，大多数时候她都能出现，不会让你空等。要说惹麻烦，大事上她总把握得当；小事的话，只要留意她在店里是否「过分殷勤」，大概率就是在弥补某个小祸，「悄悄」收拾残局了。
Content.LocalizedString: Looking for her to make deliveries? Open your Bagel, ask a few simple questions… Most of the time she'll show up and won't keep you waiting. As for causing trouble, she handles big things appropriately. For small matters, just watch if she's being overly helpful around the shop. That usually means she's making up for some minor mishap, quietly cleaning up the mess.

Content.SourceString: ……伊里卡，他的问题不在「闯祸」，而是「非要比别人更聪明」。尤其是当有个同龄人在场时，他的小脑袋就开始冒出点小火花。聪明是真聪明，只可惜都用在添麻烦上了。
Content.LocalizedString: Illica… his problem isn't causing trouble but insisting on being smarter than everyone else. Especially when there's someone his age around, his little brain starts sparking. He's genuinely clever, but unfortunately uses it all for making trouble.

Content.SourceString: 情报交易、异象、又或者是普通物件，无论什么样的需求，我们都乐意达成。
Content.LocalizedString: Intel trading, anomalies, or ordinary items… Whatever the demand, we're happy to fulfill it.

Content.SourceString: 这次的进度，可多亏了有人在背后「帮忙」。
Content.LocalizedString: Ah. Thanks to someone helping behind the scenes.

Content.SourceString: 这感觉，比想象中顺手。
Content.LocalizedString: This feels smoother than I expected.

Content.SourceString: 看来，我们都得到了想要的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like we both got what we wanted.

Content.SourceString: 你倒是比我预想的，要更懂我几分~
Content.LocalizedString: You knew me better than I expected.

Content.SourceString: 能真正戳中我心坎的礼物，这世上可不算多见。
Content.LocalizedString: There aren't many gifts in this world that would make me this happy.

Content.SourceString: 倒也符合你的风格。
Content.LocalizedString: I guess this is fitting of your style.

Content.SourceString: 形式如何，本就不必挂怀。这份心意，我可是实实在在收到了。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't care much about the gift itself, but I do appreciate your effort.

Content.SourceString: 感谢惠顾。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you for your patronage.

Content.SourceString: 专属派送，请签收。
Content.LocalizedString: Exclusive delivery, please sign here.

Content.SourceString: 这单，我亲自递。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll deliver this one myself.

Content.SourceString: 清算时间、到。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's settle.

Content.SourceString: 锁定全场。
Content.LocalizedString: I can see you all.

Content.SourceString: 全员签收。
Content.LocalizedString: Signed for delivery.

Content.SourceString: 到手了~希望有人会为它出个好价。
Content.LocalizedString: Phew! Hope someone will pay a good price for this.

Content.SourceString: 时间到了，去你该去的地方吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Time's up. Back to where you belong.

Content.SourceString: 若要追加服务，我可不打折。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't offer discounts for follow up services.

Content.SourceString: 任务结束了。接下来……该谈谈报酬了？
Content.LocalizedString: Mission complete. Now… shall we discuss payment?

Content.SourceString: 啊……这可不是一般的「快递件」。
Content.LocalizedString: Ah… this isn't your ordinary package.

Content.SourceString: 偶尔也会有些意想不到的收获。
Content.LocalizedString: Occasionally there are some unexpected gains.

Content.SourceString: 账单外的部分，可得亲自收下。
Content.LocalizedString: The off-the-books portion needs personal collection.

Content.SourceString: 这是我们应得的份额~
Content.LocalizedString: This is our rightful share!

Content.SourceString: 漂亮的猎物，下次该收集什么好呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Beautiful prey. What should I collect next?

Content.SourceString: 好货入库~
Content.LocalizedString: Good stuff in stock!

Content.SourceString: 机会，总藏在微末之间。
Content.LocalizedString: Opportunities always hide in the smallest details.

Content.SourceString: 临场应变才更有趣。
Content.LocalizedString: Improvisation is more interesting.

Content.SourceString: 还能利用哪些呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What else can I use?

Content.SourceString: 正合我意~
Content.LocalizedString: Perfect timing!

Content.SourceString: 难得合拍。
Content.LocalizedString: A rare moment of harmony.

Content.SourceString: 不过是……另一种结束。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just… another kind of ending.

Content.SourceString: 呵……秘密让我走到了这一步。
Content.LocalizedString: Heh… secrets brought me this far.

Content.SourceString: 我……也有束手无策的时候。
Content.LocalizedString: Even I… have moments when I'm helpless.

Content.SourceString: 一个一个来~
Content.LocalizedString: One at a time!

Content.SourceString: 拦路前可得找好目标~
Content.LocalizedString: Pick your targets before blocking the way!

Content.SourceString: 小意思，继续。
Content.LocalizedString: No big deal. Continue.

Content.SourceString: 胆子不小哦~
Content.LocalizedString: Pretty bold of you!

Content.SourceString: 动作挺灵活的嘛~
Content.LocalizedString: Pretty agile, aren't you!

Content.SourceString: 看来，这单得再加点附加费。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like this job needs some additional fees.

Content.SourceString: 每场混乱都要有人收尾……我可不免费登场。
Content.LocalizedString: Every mess needs someone to clean it up… I don't work for free.

Content.SourceString: 应邀而来，我可不想白跑一趟。
Content.LocalizedString: Invited guest here. I don't want this to be a wasted trip.

Content.SourceString: 你的特急件。
Content.LocalizedString: Your express delivery.

Content.SourceString: 快递上门了~
Content.LocalizedString: Here's your delivery!

Content.SourceString: 情报确认。
Content.LocalizedString: Intel confirmed.

Content.SourceString: 在空中看清局势了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Aren't things clearer when you're looking from above?

Content.SourceString: 感觉不错。
Content.LocalizedString: Feels good.

Content.SourceString: 轮到专业人士出手了~
Content.LocalizedString: Time for the professionals to take over!

Content.SourceString: 换班了，别让我收拾太久。
Content.LocalizedString: Shift change. Don't make me clean up for too long.

Content.SourceString: 挺热闹的嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: Pretty lively here.

Content.SourceString: 做得很好。
Content.LocalizedString: Well done.

Content.SourceString: 正好让我们发挥。
Content.LocalizedString: Perfect chance for us to shine.

Content.SourceString: 哈索尔，放松点。
Content.LocalizedString: Hathor, relax.

Content.SourceString: 剩下的交给大人们来处理。
Content.LocalizedString: Leave the rest to the adults.

Content.SourceString: 送上门的机会。
Content.LocalizedString: An opportunity served on a silver platter.

Content.SourceString: 刚好落点。
Content.LocalizedString: Perfect positioning.

Content.SourceString: 下次得加把劲~
Content.LocalizedString: You'll need to try harder next time!

Content.SourceString: 你得更快点才行。
Content.LocalizedString: You need to be faster than that.
